meta.name: Pursuit UP
meta.description:
Pursuit UP celebrates the outdoor lifestyle and the people that love spending quality time with friends and family in the outdoors and provides an emotional connection with viewers with a passion for hunting, fishing and conservation.

Shows: Higdon Outdoors Tv, The Luke Branquinho Show, Wiebe Trapline Adventures, Yamaha Adventure Realized, Slock Master
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
